section_summary.extract_value: This section describes 'Study 1', which aimed to assess whether insight problem-solving predicts creative achievements. The study utilized four insight problem-solving tasks, the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ) to measure creative productivity across 10 domains, and the NEO Five Factor Inventory (FFI) to assess personality and control for its known correlation with creative ability.
